subject: Prep: Exec sales readout — playbook + account-by-account asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Prep: Exec sales readout — playbook + account-by-account asks

Team —

We’ve got the exec readout next Wednesday and I want the sales slate to be crystal: a single-sheet playbook + concise account-by-account notes we can hand the execs. Goal is to show forecast hygiene, risk, and any asks (credits, legal blockers, procurement timelines).

Ask from me: by EOD Monday (22 Feb) please provide the following for your owners/segments:
- One-line account status (green/amber/red) + reason (max 2 short bullets).
- Most likely ARR contribution for the quarter (USD).
- Key blocker and suggested next-step owner (Sales/CS/Legal/Eng).
- Any requested exec action (e.g., approve credit, escalate procurement).

I attached a playbook template (exec_readout_account_playbook_20270220.xlsx). Use the Owner column and keep notes short — we’ll roll into a consolidated sheet and a 2-slide summary.

Priority accounts to cover: ACME Digital (deal id RDW-2027-ACME-1129), BrightHealth, and the 3 high-velocity SMBs in the midwest list. If you don’t own a given account, still flag any cross-sell/license timing that affects forecast.

I’ll consolidate and send the single-sheet forecast by Tue night for review. If there are any red accounts that require an exec touch, mark them with the ‘Escalate’ tag in the spreadsheet.

Thanks — keep it tight.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: exec_readout_account_playbook_20270220.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet template)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep: Exec sales readout — playbook + account-by-account asks

Got it — I’ll own consolidation for enterprise deals (ACME, BrightHealth, Northwell cluster).

Quick notes:
- I’m attaching the latest owner-level forecast extract (acme_forecast_by_owner_20270220.csv). Use the "most likely" column; I’ve reconciled differences between CRM and the spreadsheet.
- For ACME: legal has asked for a revised data-retention clause; delays procurement by ~2 weeks unless we approve the standard exception. Laura, can you confirm if we can greenlight a limited exception to keep the close in this quarter?
- For BrightHealth: procurement timeline is now explicit — Anna Li says they’ll complete PO by 03/08 if we provide SOC2 evidence and the standard addendum (she attached their timeline below).

I’ll add the owner-level numbers into Marissa’s template and ping owners for one-line statuses.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_forecast_by_owner_20270220.csv (CSV, 24 rows)

Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep: Exec sales readout — playbook + account-by-account asks

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Quick update from BrightHealth: procurement is aligning calendars — we’ve circulated the SOC2 report internally and legal expects the addendum review to finish by 03/01. If Redwood can confirm retention terms (30 days for logs, 12 months for metrics) we’ll be ready to issue the PO by 03/08 as noted.

For the readout: if it helps, I can provide a one-line confirmation of the PO timeline for the exec slides.

—Anna Li
Senior Manager, Vendor Ops
BrightHealth

Attachment: brighthealth_procurement_timeline.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)

Subject: Re: Prep: Exec sales readout — playbook + account-by-account asks

Quick answers:
- ACME Digital (RDW-2027-ACME-1129) — AMBER. Legal will not sign retention exception as-is; proposed path: 1) offer a time-bound exception (90 days) + escalated SLA credits if retained data surfaces a compliance issue; 2) if execs approve, we close this quarter. Laura (Legal) available for a 20-min slot Tue 2/23 11:00 PT to brief execs.
- BrightHealth — GREEN (procurement on track); Anna’s timeline matches our view.
- Midwest SMB cluster — RED for 2 accounts (budget reallocation). Recommend we deprioritize those two for this quarter.

I’ll populate the playbook template with the above and tag items that need exec approval.

—Laura

Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Prep: Exec sales readout — playbook + account-by-account asks

Thanks everyone — this is exactly what we need. Plan:
1) Aditya will ingest owner numbers and generate the consolidated single-sheet by EOD Tue (22 Feb).
2) Laura will draft the suggested exception language and be on the Tue 11:00 PT exec slot to present rationale if leadership greenlights.
3) Hannah / Vivek, please confirm the two SMB accounts to deprioritize and draft one-line notes for the readout.
4) I’ll assemble the slide 2 executive summary and share final packet Wed 06:30 PT for an internal 07:00 dry run.

If there are any last-minute red flags, flag them in the sheet with the tag ESCALATE and copy me. Otherwise I’ll send the consolidated playbook to the execs Tue night.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
